sections.title: Talk about general obligations
sections.content: You know *hay* from Unit 9. Use *hay que* + infinitive when something needs to be done in general, without naming a specific person.

items.english: You have to work today. / It is necessary to work today.

sections.content: *Hay que* is impersonal: it never changes for the person (*hay que trabajar*). Use *tienes que trabajar* only when you mean one person, "you".
